note: ui.shadcn.com — the shadcn/ui docs site with three framework mirrors (radix, base, aria) plus /docs/react for the AI components. Each /docs/components/<framework>/<name> page documents one registry component and the slug is the item name. 6 of the 7 url-less items attach: the aria-only attachment, bubble, marker and message pages, and the react-only message-scroller and questionnaire. The sitemap also has /blocks/<category> and /charts/<name> pages, but those are category listings, not the components themselves, so they are not in match. robots.txt allows /.
